meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 装上后,当分析 Figma 文件时,Claude 会读取文件内容并生成一个可交互的设计知识图谱,包含页面、屏幕、组件、组件集、实例与设计令牌,并自动打开 kind:"design" 面板。
howto.when: 当你知道 Figma 文件的网址或文件 key,让 Claude 分析时就会触发;还需提前配置 FIGMA_TOKEN 环境变量。

say.text: 用中文分析 Figma 文件 key 为 def456 的设计
理解这个 Figma 设计并生成可交互图谱
say.note: 会自动打开设计图谱面板。

howto.what_en: After installation, when analyzing a Figma file, Claude reads the file and produces an interactive design knowledge graph covering pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, and design tokens, then opens a kind:"design" dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a Figma file URL or file key and ask Claude to analyze it. A FIGMA_TOKEN environment variable must be set beforehand.

say_en.note: It scans the file and builds the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Analyze the design for Figma key def456 in Chinese
Understand this Figma design and build an interactive graph
say_en.note: It opens the design dashboard automatically.
